candidate_error_statistic: prediction_to_reference nearest3d p90 on exact candidate points
candidate_error_interpretation: reference-conditioned point-set diagnostic, not continuous surface certification
candidate_reference_support: all sampled candidate points must have a UAS point within 0.5m XY to label candidate_ok; otherwise unknown
denominators: native UAS points in selected cells
missing_prediction: zero reference recovery; precision and prediction error null
missing_reference: unknown; never zero error or success
reference_use: evaluation only; no registration, candidate selection, thresholds or optimizer updates

parameter_provenance.tolerances_m: retained unvalidated sensitivity axes of prior_use_height_probe_v2, fixed before current UAS measurements
parameter_provenance.reference_xy_radius_m: new diagnostic matching support radius for this development comparison; report distances and unmatched counts, no official accuracy claim
parameter_provenance.p90: new descriptive candidate point-set error statistic; no tuning on current reference

comparison_axes.decision_only: A methods passed to identical fixed-source/texturing geometry and identical fixed-geometry GS where executed
comparison_axes.reconstruction_only: same measured A handoff, candidate points, support, and view roles across B arms
comparison_axes.full_method: matched A/B crossings only; no extrapolation from missing cells or unexecuted strong published solvers

visual_contract.surface: standalone scientific PNG/PDF plus local interactive 3D inspection application
visual_contract.risk_coverage: scatter of every preregistered sensitivity setting, stratified tolerance and condition, denominator = selected unique cells; null risk absent from axis and listed separately
visual_contract.reconstruction: same-view initial/final/target images and native MVS/ALS/UAS with extracted surfaces; UAS evaluation-only
visual_contract.palette: blue, orange, olive, gold, pink; marker/line shape also distinguishes methods
visual_contract.unknown: explicit null/unknown values, no interpolation across unmatched risk or coverage
